entries.1d9d84d44490ad3c: Under its management philosophy, 'to sincere employees, understanding customers, reliable suppliers, steadfast subcontractors and all others involved in the business, we consider everyone a business partner, and through a relationship of strong mutual trust, we aim to become Japan's top renovation company in name and in fact,' the company will work to provide high-quality services that meet market needs as a good partner to its customers, real estate companies and other businesses, and strive to improve its sustainable corporate value. In addition, alongside deepening its existing businesses, the company is pursuing the expansion of its service lineup in the housing and real estate stock domain as one of its growth strategies.

entries.30dd80d612a57645: In its core Renovation Business, the company adopts a business model in which each employee handles everything from customer response to construction management, and it has a stable order base centered on restoration work, built on continuing relationships with customers that are real estate companies and other businesses. The company is also expanding its construction network of specialist contractors in each construction field that serve as subcontractors, and in May 2026 it made Daiichi Giken Co., Ltd., which carries out large-scale repair work for condominiums, buildings and other properties, a subsidiary, thereby incorporating its construction technical capability and its order base with major developers.
entries.339711d836039151: The company's main business is contracting and construction management for renovation work, including restoration work and renovation work on detached houses, apartment buildings and rental housing, as well as house cleaning and maintenance work during occupancy.
